channel.title: Chronohaze Notes Feed
channel.description: Research notes and technical updates from Feier Lyu on optimization, Isabelle/HOL, and related mathematical work.

item.title: One Negative Residual Is Not Enough: The Structure of Negative Curvature in Network Localization
item.description: A July 2026 research record on how a failed dual lower-bound route led from projected edge budgets to stress-rigidity structure, multi-edge coupling, and dimension-dependent saddles.

item.title: Convexity in the Necessity Direction of Theorem 11
item.description: A note on the convexification step in the necessity direction of Theorem 11, including the envelope submeasure, fragmentation numbers, and the bridge from a general distribution class U to the convex setting used in Lemma 18 and Theorem 19.

item.title: Exact Huber GLMs after Sparsification: Active Curvature and Kink Switching
item.description: A note on whether sparsified local refinement can preserve the active quadratic curvature of exact Huber losses while controlling affine-tail behavior and switching near the Huber kink.

item.title: Formalizing Submodular Greedy Is Now in the AFP
item.description: A short reflection on the publication of an Isabelle/HOL formalization of submodular greedy algorithms in the Archive of Formal Proofs, and on the proof architecture exposed by formalization.

item.title: TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking
item.description: A technical note on two-timescale GDA, hypergradient tracking, and second-order control in nonconvex minimax optimization.

item.title: From Dual Score to Saddle Certificates: A Small New Step
item.description: A new step from an instance-level dual score toward stationary witnesses, projected retention, Hessian structure, and cycle-rank saddle certificates for network localization.

item.title: Moving Forward After Submodular Optimization: Projected Gradient Descent in Isabelle/HOL
item.description: Originally posted on May 22, this note records the structure of a second Isabelle/HOL optimization project and predates the AFP publication of the submodular entry on May 26. The PGD project was submitted to AFP on July 2 and is awaiting review.

item.title: What I Really Got When a Dual Route Failed
item.description: When the most natural Lagrangian dual routes collapse to the trivial 0 bound, what remains is a dual-based structural score tied to Range(B), cycle consistency, and instance difficulty.

item.title: From One Theorem to a Framework: New Progress on My Isabelle Project in Submodular Optimization
item.description: Originally posted on March 14; the July update adds later status without changing the original date. The submodular entry was published in AFP on May 26, and the repository continued afterward with the StochasticGreedy theorem line.

item.title: Metalcore Piano Lab | From Audio to Chart: A Discretization Experiment (WIP)
item.description: From continuous audio to playable charts: onset detection, beat grids, section alignment, and playability constraints.

item.title: Spring 2026 | A New Research Direction
item.description: Beginning undergraduate research in Cornell ORIE on first-order methods for constrained and composite optimization.

item.title: Early Project Note: Formalising Submodular Greedy
item.description: A December 2025 stage record; the project was subsequently published in AFP 2026, and the current repository also contains a post-publication StochasticGreedy extension.

item.title: My First Isabelle Formalization Project
item.description: Embedding verifiability into proof writing: from motivation to the Nemhauser–Wolsey theorem.
